title: Interactive: native and three corrections
caption: Time slider, run selector, membrane clipping, slices and particles (three.js).
simulations: One seed per path, conversion (20,000 A → B, k = 0.5), recorded every 0.25 s to 2 s into results bundles (sims/render_3d.py). Native particles are placed at their nodes from VCell's per-node counts.
interpretation: Explore any path at any recorded time.
